192b42a82d7ef4d1.summary: The add-on can send bug, crash and session reports through a relay. Players can use the bug-report option, and the relay keeps the private reporting details off their computers.

8f7e0c6c4d9da99a.headline: Simplified help page
8f7e0c6c4d9da99a.summary: The add-on’s help page no longer includes setup notes intended for project maintainers. Players looking for game help will see the player-facing guidance.

8c9140fe7e1f0dc5.summary: Players can use different frame rates and screen refresh rates without the add-on forcing a 60 Hz setting. Existing installs also move away from the old default; an optional frame-rate cap remains available.

bcbb1c02777ede89.headline: Clearer messages during play
bcbb1c02777ede89.summary: Players will see important notices, such as warnings about saves, while routine actions handled automatically stay out of the way. A setting can show the extra details if wanted.

de87130ff157670d.headline: Easier ways to report problems
de87130ff157670d.summary: Players can open a bug report with a screenshot and details about what happened, or have crash and freeze reports sent automatically. This makes more information available when diagnosing problems.

b76e26e305487733.headline: Better recovery when sound disconnects
b76e26e305487733.summary: If the only sound output briefly disappears, the add-on can help restore sound and prevent a related endless loading screen in the first game. Players may see a notice if sound is lost.

bdf43700019fd7a8.headline: Loading screen fix updated
bdf43700019fd7a8.summary: The add-on’s version information was updated alongside an earlier fix for endless loading screens in the first game. Players with that issue may notice the fix; the version change itself is behind the scenes.

d63080bb72722cee.headline: Fix for endless loading screens
d63080bb72722cee.summary: The add-on can recover from a particular sound-related problem that could leave the first game stuck on a loading screen. Players affected by that issue may notice the difference.

49c9de4dbf167202.headline: Freeze reports include more detail
49c9de4dbf167202.summary: Before closing a frozen game, the add-on now saves a snapshot that can help explain what happened. Players may notice the game closes as before; the extra diagnostic detail is behind the scenes.

d663737ae20c98d0.headline: Fix for the Quit Game crash
d663737ae20c98d0.summary: The add-on now prevents a crash or freeze that could happen when leaving a game, and can analyze crash snapshots to help identify problems. Players may notice the improved exit behavior.

9495393c825cb64e.headline: First release of the hotfix
9495393c825cb64e.summary: The add-on backs up saves and can restore a damaged save, helps with crashes and freezes, and includes a panic shortcut. Players can install it alongside the game without changing game files.

d41ffd5b28dbbbb4.headline: A new screenshot overlay and clean cards
d41ffd5b28dbbbb4.summary: The add-on has been rebuilt with settings, countdowns, key bindings and per-character notes. Players can also take a clean character card screenshot, with character details shown in the image.

6efd8cf5ab344763.headline: Alerts when data fetching keeps failing
6efd8cf5ab344763.summary: The project can now send a check-in after each data-fetching cycle, which can trigger an email alert if fetching keeps failing. This is behind the scenes; visitors won’t notice a difference on the website.

088d9f82018f72b1.headline: Data fetching moved onto the server
088d9f82018f72b1.summary: A service on the server now refreshes add-on statistics and recent activity, replacing the previous scheduled process. This keeps the website’s live data updating without requiring a full site rebuild; visitors will notice the updated figures and activity.
